title: Total Quality Management (TQM)
overview: This course provides participants with an in-depth understanding of the history and evolution of quality concepts, including the contributions of renowned quality gurus and tools. Through interactive workshops and role plays, participants will explore the application of various quality systems, models, and methodologies, such as excellence awards, ISO systems, Lean, and Six Sigma. The course focuses on practical applications, equipping participants with the skills to implement powerful quality tools used by leading organizations. By the end of the program, participants will gain best practices for selecting, designing, and applying quality structures and tools in their organizations.
audience: This course is designed for individuals, managers, and supervisors engaged in implementing quality models, TQM, ISO standards, and excellence awards, as well as those focused on improving organizational performance.
methodology: The course uses workshops, role plays, and group debriefs to help participants grasp key quality concepts and applications. It features hands-on exercises with quality tools, supported by instructional videos on quality systems. Team discussions and presentations foster a deeper understanding of the subject matter, enhancing participants' ability to apply the concepts in real-world scenarios.
competencies: Selection of quality models and systems
Utilization of Lean and Six Sigma methodologies
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Explain the significance of quality models and identify key concepts and frameworks developed by quality gurus.
Understand the critical success factors for deploying Total Quality Management (TQM).
Utilize TQM tools to improve customer satisfaction and enhance organizational processes.
Apply benchmarking techniques to strengthen quality initiatives.
Implement widely recognized improvement methodologies, including Lean and Six Sigma.
